# OneArm2stage: — Phase II Single-Arm Two-Stage Designs with Time-to-Event Outcomes <a href='https://github.com/thomas-arocena/OneArm2stage'><img src='man\figures\logo.png' align="right" height="175" /></a>

This is a fork from Xiaomeng Yuan’s OneArm2stage. The primary goal of
this fork was to implement a way to pass the accrual time instead of
accrual rate to `phase2.TTE` for Single Stage. As the original package
seems no longer maintained, this is also a way to keep the package
alive.

## Installation

You can install the package with `pak`:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("thomas-arocena/OneArm2stage")
```

## phase2.TTE with accrual time

``` r
OneArm2stage::phase2.TTE(shape=1, S0=0.1, x0=1, hr=0.9, tf=3, ta=3, alpha=0.05, beta=0.1)
```

    $param
      shape  S0  hr alpha beta ta x0 tf q_value prStop restricted
    1     1 0.1 0.9  0.05  0.1  3  1  3     0.5      0          0

    $Single_stage
      nsingle ratesingle  csingle
